The model gives the Austrians a 54% win probability, nearly triple Jordan's 19% chance, suggesting a mismatch in quality despite the neutral venue. While Jordan will aim to stay compact and frustrate their opponents, Austria's technical edge and deeper talent pool should prove decisive in securing three points.
